plan.problem: The post-merge adversarial audit reproduced Scope aliasing and Git quoted-path corruption because changed paths are line/tab parsed and then normalized with trim and backslash replacement.
plan.currentContract: Scope now preserves NUL-delimited literal Git paths, but change-risk-policy.cjs still normalizes backslashes and ./ prefixes in Git-derived paths before Risk/Impact classification.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: A literal repository filename such as data\works.js can be rewritten to data/works.js downstream and inherit the known-domain exemption, bypassing the unknown-code Full/HQ floor.
plan.design: Preserve Git-derived path strings exactly in normalizeRiskPath/collectRiskRequirements and executable-path matching. Risk policy should classify literal repository identities without separator or prefix rewriting.
alternativesRejected: Teach the existing line parser to decode Git C-style quoting; NUL-delimited output avoids quoting entirely.
Continue normalizing both plan patterns and Git paths; this preserves unsafe aliasing between distinct repository names.
plan.compatibility: Ordinary repository paths keep the same Scope results. Plan path-pattern normalization remains unchanged; only Git-derived path identity stops being normalized.
boundaryCases: Leading-space path must not match the same path without the leading space.
Unicode path must be returned exactly rather than Git C-quoted text.
Tab and newline within filenames must survive collection as part of one path.
Backslash and quote characters must remain literal Git path characters.
Rename output must preserve both old and new literal paths.
Untracked worktree paths must use the same NUL-safe identity.
Literal root filename data\works.js must remain distinct from data/works.js and receive unknown-code risk/impact treatment.
testPlan: Create a temporary real Git repository containing leading-space, Unicode, tab, newline, backslash and quote filenames.
Assert collectChangedPaths returns exact literal names from commit diff.
Assert untracked worktree collection preserves unusual names.
Assert Scope does not trim a leading-space changed path into an allowed path.
Run Change Operations regression suite and trusted Change PR Gate.
Assert classifyRiskPath and collectRiskRequirements do not alias data\works.js onto known domain data.
Assert deriveRequiredImpacts requires risk.high-risk-review for the literal backslash JavaScript filename.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging Change OS only. Incorrect parsing could over-allow or falsely reject changes, so trusted gate review and post-fix canary are required.
